---
title: "Coding Workspace"
subtitle: "Read each transcript once: select a passage, then tick every theme it speaks to — in every thematic analysis you're running — in one go."
---

```{=html}
<div id="tb-no-project-alert" class="alert alert-warning d-none">
<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i> No active project selected. <a href="projects.html">Go to Projects</a> to create or open one.
</div>

<div id="tb-workspace-content" class="d-none">
<div class="card tb-ws-toolbar mb-3">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="min-w-0">
<span class="tb-eyebrow">Project</span>
<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
<h2 class="h5 mb-0 text-truncate" id="tb-project-title">—</h2>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0 flex-shrink-0" id="tb-edit-project-btn" title="Edit project details"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i> Edit</button>
</div>
<div class="text-muted small" id="tb-project-meta">—</div>
</div>
<div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2">
<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group" aria-label="Undo and redo">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="tb-undo-btn" disabled title="Undo (Ctrl+Z)"><i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise"></i> Undo</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="tb-redo-btn" disabled title="Redo (Ctrl+Y)"><i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise"></i> Redo</button>
</div>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" id="tb-manage-themes-btn"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> Codebook</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" id="tb-add-source-btn"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> Add Source</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="tb-workspace-row">
<!-- Sources -->
<div class="card tb-panel tb-sources-card">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span>Sources</span><span class="tb-panel-sub" id="tb-sources-count"></span></div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body" id="tb-sources-list"></div>
</div>

<!-- Transcript -->
<div class="card tb-panel tb-transcript-card">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header">
<span id="tb-active-source-name">—</span>
<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm tb-segmented" role="group" aria-label="Show">
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="tbTxView" id="tb-view-text" value="text" checked>
<label class="btn btn-outline-primary" for="tb-view-text"><i class="bi bi-file-text me-1"></i>Transcript</label>
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="tbTxView" id="tb-view-refs" value="refs">
<label class="btn btn-outline-primary" for="tb-view-refs"><i class="bi bi-list-check me-1"></i>Coded (<span id="tb-refs-count">0</span>)</label>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body">
<div id="tb-source-attributes" class="mb-2"></div>
<div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-1 mb-2" id="tb-lens-bar"></div>
<div class="tb-transcript" id="tb-transcript-text"></div>
<div class="d-none" id="tb-refs-list"></div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Coding panel -->
<div class="card tb-panel tb-coding-panel" id="tb-coding-panel">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header">
<span id="tb-cp-title"><i class="bi bi-highlighter me-1"></i>Code a passage</span>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0 text-muted d-none" id="tb-cp-cancel" title="Clear (Esc)" aria-label="Clear selection"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>
</div>
<div class="tb-cp-top">
<div id="tb-cp-quote" class="tb-cp-quote is-empty">Select a passage in the transcript to code it.</div>
<div id="tb-cp-refs" class="small mt-2"></div>
<div class="alert alert-success py-1 px-2 small mt-2 mb-0 d-none" id="tb-cp-status" role="status"></div>
</div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body">
<p class="small text-muted mb-0" id="tb-cp-hint">Tick every theme the passage speaks to, in every analysis. One passage can carry a cause, a challenge and an affected group at once, so each transcript only needs one reading.</p>

<div id="tb-cp-themes"></div>

<div class="tb-cp-section-label">Details</div>
<div data-speaker-wrap class="mb-2 d-none">
<label class="form-label small mb-1" for="tb-cp-speaker">Speaker (FGD)</label>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="tb-cp-speaker"></select>
</div>
<div class="form-check form-switch mb-1">
<input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="tb-cp-weight-toggle">
<label class="form-check-label small" for="tb-cp-weight-toggle">Importance score (1–10)</label>
</div>
<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mb-2">
<input type="range" min="1" max="10" value="5" class="form-range tb-weight-slider" id="tb-cp-weight" aria-label="Importance score">
<span class="badge bg-secondary" id="tb-cp-weight-value">5</span>
</div>
<label class="form-label small mb-1" for="tb-cp-memo">Memo (optional)</label>
<textarea class="form-control form-control-sm" id="tb-cp-memo" rows="2"></textarea>
</div>
<div class="card-footer tb-cp-footer d-flex gap-2">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-accent flex-grow-1" id="tb-cp-apply" disabled><i class="bi bi-check2 me-1"></i><span id="tb-cp-apply-label">Apply codes</span></button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger d-none" id="tb-cp-delete" title="Delete this coded reference (Delete key)"><i class="bi bi-trash me-1"></i>Delete</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<button type="button" id="tb-code-selection-btn" class="btn btn-sm btn-accent d-none" style="position:absolute;z-index:1050;">
<i class="bi bi-highlighter"></i> Code selection
</button>

<!-- ============================ MODAL: Add/Edit Source ============================ -->
<div class="modal fade" id="tb-modal-add-source" tabindex="-1">
<div class="modal-dialog modal-lg">
<div class="modal-content">
<div class="modal-header"><h5 class="modal-title">Add Source</h5><button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="modal-body" id="tb-source-form">
<input type="hidden" id="tbf-source-id">
<div class="grid gap-2 mb-3">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6">
<label class="form-label" for="tbf-source-type">Source Type</label>
<select class="form-select" id="tbf-source-type">
<option value="KII">Key Informant Interview (KII)</option>
<option value="FGD">Focus Group Discussion (FGD)</option>
<option value="Interview">Individual / In-depth Interview</option>
<option value="Survey">Open-ended Survey Response</option>
<option value="Document">Document</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6">
<label class="form-label" for="tbf-source-name">Source Name</label>
<input class="form-control" id="tbf-source-name" placeholder="e.g. KII-06">
</div>
</div>

<fieldset class="border rounded p-2 mb-3">
<legend class="float-none w-auto px-1 small text-muted" id="tbf-attr-legend">Respondent / Source Attributes</legend>
<div class="grid gap-2">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6"><label class="form-label small" for="tbf-source-respondentid" id="tbf-respondentid-label">Respondent ID</label><input class="form-control form-control-sm" id="tbf-source-respondentid"></div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6" id="tbf-sex-wrap"><label class="form-label small" for="tbf-source-sex">Sex</label>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="tbf-source-sex"><option value=""></option><option>Female</option><option>Male</option><option>Other</option><option>Prefer not to say</option></select>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 d-none" id="tbf-participants-wrap">
<div class="small fw-semibold mb-1">Participants in the group</div>
<div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-end gap-2">
<div><label class="form-label small mb-0" for="tbf-part-women">Women</label><input type="number" min="0" step="1" inputmode="numeric" class="form-control form-control-sm tb-num" id="tbf-part-women"></div>
<div><label class="form-label small mb-0" for="tbf-part-men">Men</label><input type="number" min="0" step="1" inputmode="numeric" class="form-control form-control-sm tb-num" id="tbf-part-men"></div>
<div><label class="form-label small mb-0" for="tbf-part-undisclosed">Not disclosed</label><input type="number" min="0" step="1" inputmode="numeric" class="form-control form-control-sm tb-num" id="tbf-part-undisclosed"></div>
<div class="tb-part-total">Total <strong id="tbf-part-total">0</strong></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6"><label class="form-label small" for="tbf-source-location">Location</label><input class="form-control form-control-sm" id="tbf-source-location"></div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6"><label class="form-label small" for="tbf-source-institution">Institution</label><input class="form-control form-control-sm" id="tbf-source-institution"></div>
<div class="g-col-12">
<label class="form-label small" for="tbf-source-stakeholder">Stakeholder type(s)</label>
<div class="tb-tags form-control form-control-sm" id="tbf-stakeholder-tags">
<input id="tbf-source-stakeholder" list="tbf-stakeholder-options" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Type a stakeholder type, then press Enter">
</div>
<datalist id="tbf-stakeholder-options"></datalist>
<div class="form-text">Type your own, or pick a suggestion. Add more than one when a group mixes stakeholders.</div>
</div>
</div>
</fieldset>

<div id="tbf-speakers-wrap" class="mb-3 d-none">
<label class="form-label" for="tbf-source-speakers">Speakers (comma-separated, e.g. Moderator, P1, P2, P3)</label>
<input class="form-control" id="tbf-source-speakers" placeholder="Moderator, P1, P2, P3">
</div>

<label class="form-label">Text</label>
<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm mb-2" role="group">
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="srcImportMode" id="tbf-mode-paste" value="paste" checked>
<label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="tbf-mode-paste">Paste Text</label>
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="srcImportMode" id="tbf-mode-txt" value="txt">
<label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="tbf-mode-txt">Upload .txt</label>
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="srcImportMode" id="tbf-mode-docx" value="docx">
<label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="tbf-mode-docx">Upload .docx</label>
<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="srcImportMode" id="tbf-mode-csv" value="csv">
<label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="tbf-mode-csv">Upload .csv / .xlsx</label>
</div>
<div id="tbf-text-wrap" class="mb-3">
<textarea class="form-control" id="tbf-source-text" rows="6" placeholder="Paste the transcript or open-ended responses here…"></textarea>
<div class="form-text d-none" id="tbf-text-note">Coded passages follow your edits; any whose words you remove will be dropped (you'll be asked first, and can undo).</div>
</div>
<div id="tbf-file-wrap" class="mb-3 d-none">
<input type="file" class="form-control" id="tbf-source-file">
<div class="form-text">DOCX and CSV/XLSX are parsed entirely in your browser (via mammoth.js / SheetJS) — nothing is uploaded to a server.</div>
</div>

<label class="form-label" for="tbf-source-memo">Memo</label>
<textarea class="form-control" id="tbf-source-memo" rows="2"></textarea>
</div>
<div class="modal-footer">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger me-auto d-none" id="tb-delete-source-btn"><i class="bi bi-trash me-1"></i>Delete source</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Cancel</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-accent" id="tb-save-source-btn">Add Source</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- ============================ MODAL: Codebook ============================ -->
<div class="modal fade" id="tb-modal-codebook" tabindex="-1">
<div class="modal-dialog modal-lg modal-dialog-scrollable">
<div class="modal-content">
<div class="modal-header"><h5 class="modal-title">Codebook — analyses, themes &amp; sub-themes</h5><button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="modal-body">
<p class="small text-muted">Each <strong>thematic analysis</strong> answers its own research question and has its own themes; one passage can be coded under several analyses at once. Use <i class="bi bi-arrow-bar-left"></i> to promote a sub-theme to a main theme, <i class="bi bi-arrow-bar-right"></i> to make a theme a sub-theme of the one above it, or <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i> to rename, recolour or move it anywhere.</p>
<div id="tb-theme-tree-editor" class="mb-2"></div>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" id="tb-cb-add-analysis"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> New thematic analysis</button>
<hr>
<div class="small fw-semibold mb-2">Add a theme</div>
<div class="grid gap-2 align-items-end">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4"><label class="form-label small" for="tbf-theme-name">Name</label><input class="form-control" id="tbf-theme-name"></div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4"><label class="form-label small" for="tbf-theme-parent">Place under</label><select class="form-select" id="tbf-theme-parent"></select></div>
<div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-2"><label class="form-label small" for="tbf-theme-color">Colour</label><input type="color" class="form-control form-control-color w-100" id="tbf-theme-color" value="#1B4F9C"></div>
<div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-2"><button type="button" class="btn btn-accent w-100" id="tb-add-theme-btn">Add</button></div>
</div>
<p class="text-muted small mt-3 mb-0">Colours are a visual aid only — the theme/code <em>name</em> carries the analytical meaning (per TakwimuBridge's design principle).</p>
</div>
<div class="modal-footer"><button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { window.TB.whenReady(function () {
  if (window.TB && window.TB.seedDemoIfNeeded) window.TB.seedDemoIfNeeded();
  if (window.TB && window.TB.workspace) window.TB.workspace.init();
}); });
</script>
```
